Claim_Text: Carrier transit is 4x more influential than seller handling
Audit_Finding: Represents ratio of excess odds (+120% vs +38% per SD; 3.2x ratio), not 4x total probability or total impact.
Required_Rewrite: Carrier transit delay exhibits 3.2x the excess odds of low reviews (+120% vs +38% per standard deviation) compared to merchant handling.

Claim_Text: Carrier transit accounts for 80% of dissatisfaction risk
Audit_Finding: Conflates fulfillment duration share with dissatisfaction attribution. Standardized OR is 2.20 vs 1.38.
Required_Rewrite: Carrier transit accounts for 76.9% of total elapsed fulfillment duration and represents the primary operational predictor of low reviews.

Claim_Text: Postal carrier capacity breakdown caused the Black Friday collapse
Audit_Finding: Observational event study proves carrier duration surged by +2.7d (+3.3d total delivery) while merchant handling rose +0.6d; causal capacity proof requires carrier log data.
Required_Rewrite: Event-study decomposition demonstrates that the Black Friday rating collapse was concentrated in carrier transit duration (+2.7 days carrier / +3.3 days total) rather than merchant warehouse dispatch (+0.6 days).

Claim_Text: Premature feedback generates 26.1% of all marketplace negative reviews
Audit_Finding: 26.1% is the descriptive share of low reviews among pre-delivery surveys; 'generates' implies sole causation.
Required_Rewrite: Orders surveyed prematurely while delayed in transit account for 26.1% of all low reviews on the marketplace.

Claim_Text: Customers do not care about freight price
Audit_Finding: Bivariate correlation is weak (r=-0.065) and controlled OR is 0.998 (p=0.45), but customers care about value relative to delivery speed.
Required_Rewrite: Freight share exhibits no statistically significant direct association with customer dissatisfaction once controlling for distance and delivery timeliness.

Claim_Text: Olist CRM software defect caused negative reviews
Audit_Finding: Survey fired when estimated delivery date expired while order was in transit; delay is an essential co-factor.
Required_Rewrite: Fulfillment-SLA Asynchrony: automated feedback requests triggered upon estimated date expiration solicit ratings before physical delivery occurs.
